about: Synthetic calibration set for the PII screen (issue #198). Every name, number, account and address is invented for this file; none comes from real records, and account, passport and resident numbers have impossible lengths or dates so they cannot match a real one. Positives name or number a person with information about them; hard negatives look personal (roles, placeholders, field names, identifiers, ports, codes) but identify nobody. Read by scripts/pii-screen-eval.ts, which sends it to a model; test/pii-screen.test.ts checks its shape and never sends it to one.
